data.desc: NewGenIVF Group is a technology-forward, diversified growth company, pursuing opportunities across real estate development, digital asset innovation and reproductive health solutions. The Company operates through NewGenProperty, focused on real estate development projects in the UAE's Ras Al Khaimah Emirate; NewGenDigital, focused on digital asset and decentralized-finance solutions; and NewGenSup, focused on health and longevity products and solutions. NewGenIVF's legacy business includes IVF and assisted reproductive treatment services across Asia. To learn more, visit www.nivf.global. Information contained on, or accessible through, the Company's website is not incorporated by reference into this press release.
